messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up — ACME POC is failing when they enable JSON mode for tool outputs. Getting schema validation errors and function call mismatches. Customer is blocked, asking for timeline and workaround. can we swarm?

jordan_se: Thanks, can you paste the exact error and a minimal payload? Also is this on hosted or dedicated?

support-bot: [auto] New error captured -> request_id=0x9f4b JSONMode: SchemaValidationError at /tool_output: expected object, received string. 429 spikes observed around the same time.

ali_ml: Got a snippet from the customer logs:
```
ERROR SchemaValidationError: validation failed for response_format
  at validate (/app/runtime/validate.js:42)
  path: /tools.extract_orders/0/order_id
  expected: string
  received: null
```

ali_ml: Looks like the model is returning a bare string (stringified JSON) instead of structured JSON. Happens when model hallucinated punctuation or included extra commentary.

mike_sre: Also seeing transient 429s in the same time window. They are on hosted trial with bursts ~30 qps — could be hitting rate limits. Suggest: 1) throttle client, 2) enable retry/backoff, 3) consider Dedicated for predictable QPS.

jordan_se: Two quick workarounds to try now: 1) switch from JSON mode to explicit function_call with a strict schema (functions API). 2) add a post-parse step to re-try parse if you get a string (cheap guard).

jordan_se: Example function definition we sent the customer: 
```json
{
  "name": "emit_order",
  "description": "Return structured order object",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "order_id": {"type": "string"},
      "amount": {"type": "number"}
    },
    "required": ["order_id","amount"]
  }
}
```

ali_ml: Another tweak: set `temperature=0` and `max_new_tokens` lower; and add a system prompt enforcing `ONLY RETURN JSON` and no commentary. If they still get stringified JSON, enable our `force_structured:true` flag in the request (internal flag for strict parser).

sam_sales: Customer also raised security questions — wants SOC2 attestation + KMS integration before moving to Dedicated. Can Security provide the pack?

mike_sre: We have SOC2 summary + KMS integration guide. I'll drop the doc links in the support ticket and offer a short tech call. Dedicated onboarding includes KMS support.

support-bot: New event -> request_id=0x9f4b validation detail: path=/tools.extract_orders/0/amount expected=number received=\"12.50\" (string).

eng-runtime: That string number is classic: model returned amount as quoted string. We should coerce types client-side or extend the function schema to accept string|number then cast. Also consider adding a small regex post-processor to convert numeric strings.

ali_ml: I'll reproduce locally with the exact prompt and function schema. If I can reproduce we can add an automatic sanitizer in the SDK: attempt JSON.parse then fallback to regex-based number coercion. Will create a tiny repro repo and link here.

jordan_se: For the customer ask on pricing: Sam, recommend offering a short Dedicated trial (1-2 weeks) with usage cap; sales can pitch reserved commit if they need sustained QPS. I can draft the quote once we confirm QPS.

sam_sales: Sounds good. Owners: ali_ml will own repro + SDK PR, jordan_se will draft pricing/commit options, mike_sre will handle SOC2/KMS docs and onboarding call. I'll update the ACME contact and set expectations.

eng-runtime: Quick note — if they want lower tail latency and no 429s, Dedicated with pinned capacity avoids rate-limit throttling. Also enabling prefix caching on repeated prefixes drastically reduces token spend for order extraction flows.

sam_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll loop in legal for the security questionnaire and schedule the tech call. If we can get the repro in 24h we can unblock ACME's trial. :thumbsup:

support-bot: [ticket #3247] Created a support ticket for ACME POC errors, assigned to ali_ml and mike_sre.

sam_sales: Closing the swarm for now — will re-open if new errors appear. Keep me posted on the SDK PR and SOC2 docs.
